files.why: Dynamic-body integration and collision impulse/momentum resolution determine both squares' post-collision velocities.
Dispatches collision handling between bodies and may apply resolution only to the moving source instead of both bodies.
Computes collision normal, displacement, and resolution state used to separate and redirect the squares.
Provides collision detection and resolveCollision behavior for the squares' area components.
Calculates the collision axis and penetration direction; an incorrect normal could send the red square backward.

diagnosis.root_cause: The body collision handler reflects each body's own velocity against the collision normal without transferring momentum to the other non-static body, treating a movable body like an immovable wall.
diagnosis.suspect_function: body() - the onPhysicsResolve callback registered in add()
diagnosis.mechanism: For the moving red square, projection is computed only from this.vel and, with restitution, this.vel becomes rejection minus the reflected projection, so it rebounds left; for the stationary blue square this.vel is zero, its projection is zero, and no impulse or velocity is ever applied to it, so it stays in place despite positional separation.
diagnosis.test_spec: Track both squares' x-centroids and x-velocities before and for about 0.5-1s after first contact: assert the blue square gains positive x-velocity and its x-position increases substantially to the right, the red square's post-collision x-velocity is near zero rather than negative and its x-position does not retreat left, and total x-momentum is approximately conserved.

fix_strategies.name: Momentum impulse in physics-resolve handler
fix_strategies.approach: In the onPhysicsResolve callback, compute relative velocity along the normal, derive an impulse from restitution and both masses (infinite mass for static bodies), remove the self-only reflection, and apply opposite impulses to the two bodies' velocities so equal-mass head-on bodies exchange normal velocity.

fix_strategies.name: Velocity exchange during positional resolution
fix_strategies.approach: In the non-static vs non-static branch of the onCollideUpdate resolver, at the single point where displacement is split by mass, also swap/transfer the normal components of velocity weighted by mass, record on the Collision that momentum was resolved to prevent the later per-body handler from reflecting velocity again, and leave tangential/friction handling unchanged.

fix_strategies.name: Central impulse solver in collision system
fix_strategies.approach: After narrowPhase detects a pair once, compute a single momentum-conserving impulse from the Collision normal, both velocities, masses and restitution, and apply it via each body's applyImpulse(), while changing body.ts so its physics-resolve handler no longer independently reflects velocity against a movable target.
